install.short_help: Install tingle onto PATH and enable bash completion.
install.long_help:
Adds tingle's bin/ folder to PATH and installs bash completion for tingle, both idempotently, by appending the necessary lines to ~/.bashrc if they are not already present.

Usage:
    tingle install

Running it more than once is safe: existing PATH and completion entries in ~/.bashrc are detected and left untouched.

linux.short_help: Run GNU/Linux tools (sed, shell) inside a container.
linux.long_help:
Runs real GNU/Linux command-line tools inside a Docker container (the current working directory mounted in at the same path), for cases where the host tool differs from its Linux counterpart in ways that break scripts or muscle memory — e.g. macOS's BSD sed vs GNU sed.

Usage:
    tingle linux shell
    tingle linux sed <sed-args...>

Examples:
    tingle linux shell
        Opens an interactive bash shell inside the tingle-linux container,
        with the current working directory mounted at the same path, so you
        can run Linux-native tools directly against your files.
